svg.title: fit — individual input checks, exact inference and retained diagnostics
svg.desc: Follow selected model and panel revisions through schema binding, fit preflight, initialization, exact particle sampling, individual diagnostics, optional LOO, conditioning and refreshed model checks. Predictive generation remains a separate action.
